title: Vibration Monitoring System & Condition Monitoring Pakistan 2026 — Vibration Sensor, Accelerometer, IEC 10816, ISO 20816, Predictive Maintenance Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete 2026 buyer guide to vibration monitoring systems and online condition monitoring in Pakistan — covering accelerometer selection (IEPE/ICP), ISO 20816 velocity limits (mm/s by machine class), WAPDA motor restart stress, wireless vs wired CMS comparison, Pakistan price table (PKR), top 5 installer mistakes, and integration with SCADA/IIoT/EMS platforms. Includes FAQ with ISO 18436-2 analyst certification guidance and ROI calculation for cement, textile, and sugar mill applications.
